links.comparator_used: Default ChatGPT-4o prompt with no reading-level instruction (FRE 11.7, FKGL 16.2 for default answers)
links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT answers (Flesch Reading Ease / Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: Readability 'significantly improved' when ChatGPT was asked to respond at a sixth-grade level; the abstract gives no numeric values for the sixth-grade condition. Default ChatGPT-4o answers had FRE 11.7 and FKGL 16.2 (college graduate level).
links.quote: When asking ChatGPT to respond at a sixth-grade level, the readability of the answers significantly improved.
